display.title: Ahavas Yisroel in the Month of Av: Hashem's Greatest Delight
display.summary_short: As the month of Av arrives, we remember that baseless hatred destroyed the Beis HaMikdash, and that nothing pleases Hashem more than His children loving one another.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show as the month of Av begins. Uncle Yossi asks what caused the sad events of this month, above all the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash in Yerushalayim, and what we can do so they never happen again. Our Chachamim teach that the main cause was sinas chinam, baseless hatred, which Hashem despises, while nothing gives Him more pleasure than Jews loving one another. He brings the Alter Rebbe's comparison: just as parents have no greater joy than seeing their children live together in love and peace, so it is with Hashem, for 'you are children to Hashem your G-d'. By practicing Ahavas Yisroel in every possible way we correct the mistakes of the past and prepare for Moshiach, who will gather every Jew from the four corners of the world back to Eretz Yisroel, the everlasting inheritance of every Jew.
display.lesson: Baseless hatred destroyed the Beis HaMikdash; loving every Jew, as Hashem's children, will bring Moshiach and rebuild it.

date.note: Cut from episode 134 (the week before Rosh Chodesh Av 5744). The same talk aired first in episode 33 (5742) and was repeated often.

sources_cited.note: The Alter Rebbe's saying: as parents delight in children who love each other, so does Hashem.
